note: Product-neutral fixtures for registries/operating-model/instance-canonical-export.schema.json and scripts/lib/instance-data-migration.mjs's evaluateInstanceCanonicalExport. Every `valid` registry must pass evaluateInstanceCanonicalExport with no problem; every `invalid` registry must produce at least one, when checked with resolvers built from plan_resolution (makeMigrationPlanResolver, keyed by plan_ref) and source_content_resolution (makeSourceContentResolver, keyed by computeSourceContentKey({repository_ref, revision, unit_refs, merge_rule_ref})) — the two EXTERNAL resolution boundaries this contract checks an export's referenced plan and every exported record's ACTUAL preserved content against. plan_resolution's entries are closed projections of the real, product-neutral instance-data-migration.fixtures.json plans (sample-migration-plan-one, sample-migration-plan-two, sample-migration-plan-three) this file reuses, so the two fixture files never drift silently apart. digest and idempotency_key values are the real, recomputed output of computeExportDigest/computeExportIdempotencyKey over each fixture's own content — a fixture is not free to pick an arbitrary value. No product literals, no absolute machine paths, no dependency on a separate Instance.
